description: Declarative inventory of controls actually emitted by tools/validate.sh. Control semantics remain in their source checks.

reserved.reason: Evidence shape reserved by docs/nips/NIP-0003-live-runtime-sessions.md; not allocated.

controls.name: Frontmatter schema
controls.purpose: Governed-document frontmatter validates against its schema.

controls.name: Document format
controls.purpose: Required document fields have valid formats.

controls.name: Fence language
controls.purpose: Shipped Markdown code fences carry language tags.

controls.name: Index integrity
controls.purpose: NIZAM.json validates and its indexed paths resolve.

controls.name: Branding and endpoint leakage
controls.purpose: Shipped content contains no prohibited branding or internal endpoints.

controls.name: Bootstrap sanity
controls.purpose: bootstrap.sh passes syntax and declared installation sanity checks.

controls.name: Version and changelog
controls.purpose: Frontmatter version changes have matching change records.

controls.name: Path resolution
controls.purpose: Concrete paths resolve in shipped documents, root README and the guide; declared examples and HTTP URLs retain their handling.

controls.name: Consistency
controls.purpose: Shipped payload, discovery and version statements remain consistent; default scope excludes root README.

controls.name: Dogfood schema validation
controls.purpose: Present local contracts, QA verdicts and run state validate against their schemas.

controls.name: Schema-family fixtures
controls.purpose: Ecosystem and runtime schema-family fixtures retain expected outcomes.

controls.name: Governance skill manifest
controls.purpose: The governance skill manifest, version parity, unique capability names, indexed module subset and contained paths validate.

controls.name: Workflow pinning
controls.purpose: External GitHub Actions references use immutable commit SHAs.

controls.name: Capability roles
controls.purpose: Capability profiles cover and correctly map the five AGF roles.

controls.name: Feature-list lifecycle
controls.purpose: Feature-list records satisfy applicable contract, QA and evidence invariants.
